decorations.description: Light blue walls with a soft gradient, enhancing the room's airy feel.
Light gray and neutral-toned flooring with subtle patterns, complementing the room’s overall aesthetic.
Several potted plants in different sizes, placed strategically around the room, adding a touch of greenery.
